rows.commentary: 0.6: Zahid Ali pitches up, and Jack Wood dispatches it powerfully to deep mid-wicket for four.
1.1: Muhammad Farooq delivers to Max Bryant, who flicks it away with precision to backward square leg for four.
1.2: Max Bryant launches Muhammad Farooq all the way over deep backward point for a magnificent six.
1.3: Muhammad Farooq goes full again, and Max Bryant lofts it clean over deep extra cover for six more.
1.4: Max Bryant works Muhammad Farooq neatly to backward square leg to pick up another boundary.
1.5: Max Bryant pushes Muhammad Farooq down towards long-on and scampers through for a single.
1.6: Muhammad Farooq is driven down the ground by Jack Wood, finding the ropes at long-on for four.
2.1: Muhammad Zuhaib is greeted by Max Bryant with a sharp cut shot past deep backward point for four.
2.2: Max Bryant dances down and launches Muhammad Zuhaib majestically over long-off for a maximum.
2.3: Muhammad Zuhaib drops it in the arc, allowing Max Bryant to carve it sweetly to deep extra cover for four.
2.4: Max Bryant sweeps hard against Muhammad Zuhaib, collecting four runs out at deep mid-wicket.
2.5: Max Bryant nudges Muhammad Zuhaib towards long-on to rotate the strike with a single.
2.6: Muhammad Zuhaib strikes as Jack Wood miscues the slog, skies it high into the V, and Ansh Tandon settles underneath it to take a sharp catch.
3.1: Ansh Tandon floats one up and Max Bryant feasts on it, launching a monstrous strike sailing all the way over long-off for a maximum.
3.6: Jack Wood delivers to Muhammad Zuhaib, punched away firmly to find the boundary rope at sweeper cover.
4.1: Max Bryant steams in and pushes it through to Zahid Ali, who works a single out toward deep mid-wicket.
4.2: Max Bryant tests Muhammad Zuhaib, who drives it cleanly down the ground to collect a single at long-off.
4.3: Max Bryant tosses it up to Zahid Ali, who sweeps it firmly into the gap at sweeper cover for a brisk couple of runs.
4.4: Max Bryant drops short and Zahid Ali capitalizes immediately, hooking it all the way over fine leg for a towering maximum.
4.5: Max Bryant strikes as Zahid Ali skies one into the grateful hands of Jack Wood, ending a brief cameo of 9 from 5 balls.
4.6: Wide from Max Bryant to Muhammad Farooq.
4.6: Max Bryant strays and Muhammad Farooq launches a ferocious pull shot soaring over backward square leg for six.
5.1: Chris Green flights it up to Muhammad Zuhaib, who rotates the strike with a delicate push to deep extra cover.
5.2: Chris Green extracts the breakthrough as Muhammad Farooq holes out to Max Bryant, departing for 6 off just 2 deliveries.
5.3: Chris Green bowls a wide to Muhammad Zuhaib.
5.3: Chris Green triumphs again, drawing the edge from Muhammad Zuhaib who picks out Nick Hobson to depart for 16.
